title: Plugin Integration Intake Payload
$comment: Defines the envelope documented in references/intake-payload-schema.md. `content`'s per-target-system shape is deliberately NOT fully encoded here (only type: object, minProperties: 1) -- the full per-record-type field list lives in notion-knowledge-management's references/notion-record-types.md and linear-work-management's references/linear-entity-fields.md, and restating it a third time here would reintroduce the exact drift risk this skill's own reference doc already fixed once (see that file's 'reference wins' framing). No script, hook, or MCP tool currently invokes this schema at runtime -- until such an invocation exists, this file mechanically catches nothing on its own; SKILL.md step 2's own procedure (the model reasoning through these same rules directly) is the only enforcement that actually runs today. This file exists so a real invocation can be wired in later without restating the envelope rules a fourth time, and so an ad-hoc check (e.g. a live `jsonschema` run) has something real to validate against.

source_plugin.description: The calling plugin's own name, exactly as installed. Caller-asserted, not host-attested -- checked for existence only, never treated as an authenticated identity (see SKILL.md's Trust Model section). Kebab-case allowlist, not just non-empty -- SKILL.md's step 2 uses this value inside a Glob pattern, where an unconstrained string (glob metacharacters, path separators) would defeat the existence check this schema is meant to gate before that procedure ever runs.

source_skill.description: The calling plugin's own skill that produced this submission. Same kebab-case allowlist and rationale as source_plugin.

operation.description: Absent means create, so every single-record caller is unchanged. See references/wmgt-intake-batch-contract.md and references/wmgt-intake-query-update-contract.md.

content.description: Shape depends on target_system -- see notion-record-types.md / linear-entity-fields.md for the authoritative per-type field list. Not fully validated here by design.

records.description: Batch form (Linear only), in place of content. Per-record shape follows the operation -- see the batch and query/update contracts.

keys.description: Query form: exact dedup keys, never search phrases.

test_run.description: Caller-asserted, like source_plugin. true redirects a mapped repository's work to its test team; it never widens scope. The approval preview must name the environment and team.

suggested_mapping.description: Untrusted evidence, not a directive -- see SKILL.md. Exactly one of notion_database/linear_target is required, matching target_system (enforced by the allOf branches below, not expressible in this sub-schema alone).
